home.title: Every field has a memory.
home.body: ITZA reads your field's history from space and replays every real season on each rotation, so you can see which would have held up best, and why.
home.eyebrow: ITZA SPACE · See Earth Through Time
home.pillars.label: What ITZA does
home.pillar.past.title: The land's past
home.pillar.past.body: Field memory: years of satellite greenness show when your field was cropped, fallow or bare.
home.pillar.present.title: Its present
home.pillar.present.body: Climate fingerprint: frost, heat, dry spells and water balance, with the hardest seasons picked out.
home.pillar.futures.title: Possible futures
home.pillar.futures.body: Season replay: each rotation runs through every real season on record, and through 2050 climates.
home.pillar.decide.title: Better decisions
home.pillar.decide.body: Evidence cards: options, never orders, each with why, evidence, benefits, gaps and risks.
home.note: Built on NASA Earth observations. ITZA supports farmer judgment and local expertise; it does not replace either.
